title: mmt-plugin install manifest, manifest_version 1
description: What mmt-plugin install wrote into <prefix>/plugins (docs/design/cli.md, sections 4 and 8): <prefix>/plugins/.mmt-plugin/<label>.json. uninstall removes only the files listed here whose sha256 is still the recorded one; doctor reads the protocol to find id and name clashes. Written last, after the files. No timestamp and no absolute path.

manifest_version.description: Bumped on any change a reader of version 1 would misread; a reader refuses a newer one.

version.description: The mmt-plugin version that installed the files.

label.description: The plugin's label (lower case); the manifest's file name is <label>.json.

id.description: The protocol id the plugin registers.

name.description: The protocol name the plugin registers (the label in upper case).

files.description: The installed files, sorted by path.

path.description: A file name in <prefix>/plugins (no directory part).
